digest.component_or_area: fetcher enrichment boundary (Cloud adapter pagination stalls)
propositions: RunawayPaginationError subclasses RuntimeError instead of BackendPaginationStallError, placing it outside the core stall hierarchy

fetch_snapshot's three enrichment re-raise clauses (parent, comment, issuelink) match only on BackendPaginationStallError and miss Cloud's error, allowing broad except Exception handlers to swallow it
A stalled Cloud pagination cursor produces a silently degraded snapshot instead of propagating the stall out of fetch_snapshot
Changing RunawayPaginationError to subclass BackendPaginationStallError makes it visible to the existing re-raise clauses and causes stalls to propagate instead of degrading
Existing except RunawayPaginationError and except RuntimeError sites remain unaffected because RuntimeError stays in the MRO after the fix
